problem.title: KISS-ICP KITTI Odom seq 08 full: upstream mechanics with and without the elevation correction
problem.question: Does the upstream-mechanics KISS-ICP configuration that matches the official code on KITTI 00/07 also match it, and the paper's 0.50 % average over 00-10, on the remaining training sequences?

variants.label: upstream profile + upstream threshold, kernel, and map insertion gate
variants.intent: Configuration that matches the official KISS-ICP code on KITTI 00/07 (papers/kiss_icp/README.md).
variants.note: Adaptive sigma min/mean/max=0.359656/0.385296/2; correspondence_multiplier=3; neighbor_voxel_radius=1; vertical_angle_correction_deg=0; mulran_deskew=off; deskewed_frames=0; deskew_timestamp_fallbacks=0; motion_guard=off; motion_guard_rejections=0; adaptive_motion_guard_acceptances=0; end_to_end_fps=27.2884; algorithm_fps=31.8996.
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: upstream mechanics + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.
variants.note: Adaptive sigma min/mean/max=0.361018/0.385989/2; correspondence_multiplier=3; neighbor_voxel_radius=1; vertical_angle_correction_deg=0; mulran_deskew=off; deskewed_frames=0; deskew_timestamp_fallbacks=0; motion_guard=off; motion_guard_rejections=0; adaptive_motion_guard_acceptances=0; end_to_end_fps=26.3466; algorithm_fps=31.4729.
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
